layers.name: Data & Auth Foundation
layers.description: Supabase client root, auth functions, storage, rate-limiting and the foundational auth/profile/household hooks that every feature builds on.

layers.name: Tasks & Scheduling Engine
layers.description: Task CRUD hooks plus the fairness/auto/smart schedulers and weekly generation that assign and plan household chores.

layers.name: Gamification & Coaching
layers.description: Rewards, achievements, challenges, pets, love-tokens, surprise/welcome gifts, easter eggs and the adaptive coaching message system.

layers.name: Notifications & Integrations
layers.description: In-app + push notifications, Google Calendar sync, WhatsApp, Sumit billing, and analytics.

layers.name: Shopping
layers.description: Shared shopping list hooks and autocomplete logic.

layers.name: UX & Preferences
layers.description: Theme/seasonal/motion/sound preferences, accessibility helpers, coaching/copy resolution and assorted UX utilities.

layers.name: App Routes (App Router)
layers.description: The authenticated (app) route group: dashboard, tasks, shopping, stats, settings, weekly, history, emergency, playlists, plus layouts and boundaries.

layers.name: Other Core Utilities
layers.description: Remaining shared library utilities not specific to a single feature domain.

tour.title: Data & Auth Foundation
tour.description: Start at the Supabase client singleton and auth layer — the data root every feature depends on.

tour.title: The App Shell
tour.description: The (app) route-group layout wires providers, guards and navigation around every authenticated screen.

tour.title: Tasks: the core loop
tour.description: useTasks drives task CRUD + realtime; the tasks route is the largest surface in the app.

tour.title: Scheduling & fairness
tour.description: auto-scheduler selects assignees by weighted load; weekly-generator composes it into a weekly plan.

tour.title: Gamification
tour.description: Rewards, achievements and challenges turn completed chores into a motivating game loop.

tour.title: Notifications & integrations
tour.description: In-app + push notifications and external integrations (Google Calendar, WhatsApp, Sumit billing).

tour.title: Insight surfaces
tour.description: task-stats powers the stats route; the dashboard aggregates everything into the landing screen.
